method: Actual in-app browser, normal game controls, separate qa=1 saves. No browser evaluation of hidden game state and no gameplay cheats.

localWebRtc.scope: Two browser tabs on the same machine connected through the real invite/reply WebRTC UI. Original media on host; procedural rendering on the second peer. Both used the same EE2 simulation.
localWebRtc.peace: Host offered peace; the second player received and accepted it. Both displayed Neutral.
localWebRtc.swap: Territory 1 against Territory 2 was proposed, received and explicitly accepted. Their owners exchanged on both clients; each retained one territory and population 5/40. Resource balances did not change.
localWebRtc.focus: Eigenes Gebiet auf Karte zeigen and H focused the host's new southeastern territory with its blue city center and citizens.
localWebRtc.gift: Host declared directed war, then reviewed and confirmed giving its remaining Territory 2. Gift remained available despite hostility. Donor became 0 territories and 0 population; recipient became 2 territories and 10/80 population.
localWebRtc.warnings: Last-territory loss warning and the concrete 1-building/5-unit gift preview were shown before confirmation.
localWebRtc.networkStatus: Both UI performance/status strings reported multiplayer without an out-of-sync flag. Both browser warning/error logs were empty.
localWebRtc.relationshipToFinalBuild: The later 6E build changes only displayed event chronology; territory-logsort-equivalence.json verifies unchanged simulation hashes and byte-identical saves.

finalSinglePlayer.setup: Selected five citizens, scouted a neutral region, and built a second city center using ordinary controls at 4x speed. No cheats. Construction cost 300 wood and 300 stone; two territories and 5/80 population were visible.
finalSinglePlayer.selection: The compact territory tab displayed both own Territories 1 and 13, map highlights, receiver parcels and object counts. Trade was disabled during hostility with a visible peace prerequisite.
finalSinglePlayer.confirmation: Selected Territory 13. Preview identified one city-center building and five citizens; no last-territory warning appeared for this additional region. Cancel then reopening the review caused no transfer.
finalSinglePlayer.gift: Confirmed Territory 13 to the AI. Own territory count changed from 2 to 1, population from 5/80 to 0/40. Territory 13 appeared in the recipient's parcel list, with one building and five citizens at the observed paused state.
finalSinglePlayer.saveLoad: Saved, reloaded the entire page and resumed the same save. Own Territory 1 remained, Territory 13 still belonged to the AI, its observed package was one building/five citizens, balances and population 0/40 persisted, and the territory gift event remained in the log.
finalSinglePlayer.presentation: Final compact tab and action buttons were visually checked at 1280x720. Confirm describes the live package and conditionally the last-territory warning. Final gameplay warning/error log was empty.

handoff.status: Fresh normal start menu fully loaded, start button enabled, Full map selected; existing normal save records remained visible and were not altered by QA games.

limits: No cross-machine or different-NAT WebRTC test; no full original-game equivalence, complete original treaty system or comprehensive rendered-performance claim.
